metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to find electric cars on cars.com but encountered ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR. Spent all 50 turns trying to access cars.com via Chrome, Firefox, curl, and Python requests. Investigated proxy settings but could not bypass the connection issue.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome, type URLs in address bar, open terminal, run bash/curl/Python commands, open Firefox, navigate Chrome UI menus, investigate system settings
metadata.failure_analysis: cars.com was inaccessible due to HTTP/2 protocol errors through the configured proxy. The model could not complete the original task because the target website was unreachable, not due to agent capability limitations.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests Chrome internal page navigation. The model demonstrated ability to type URLs and use Chrome address bar. chrome://bookmarks is always accessible and tests basic Chrome navigation without external network dependency.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome's bookmark manager (chrome://bookmarks). Evaluator uses official is_expected_url_pattern_match metric with active_url_from_accessTree getter to verify the active tab URL matches chrome://bookmarks.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter active_url_from_accessTree correctly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree, using goto_prefix='chrome://' to reconstruct internal chrome:// URLs
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly receives the rules dict (with 'expected' key) and performs regex matching against the URL pattern 'chrome://bookmarks.*'
Expected pattern 'chrome://bookmarks.*' correctly matches the Chrome bookmark manager URL (chrome://bookmarks or chrome://bookmarks/)
Single instruction requirement (open bookmark manager page) is fully covered by the URL verification
No postconfig needed since the bookmark manager page remains open as the active tab for the getter to read
